description: Inject the Rodeo Network operating-purpose and privacy boundary at session start, plus a first-run setup pointer. Static text only: the hook reads no files, transcripts, or state.

hooks.command: echo "Rodeo Network may apply to any official rodeo task, including email, sponsor or vendor invoices, ticket help, documents, schedules, committee work, and future workflows. Use the rodeo-network skill and the authenticated rodeo_network_admin MCP server. Preserve useful process knowledge under the rodeo operating seat, but capture only the rodeo-operational slice; omit unrelated personal activity, credentials, full private transcripts, and unrelated personal data. First-run check, quietly and once per session: if the local workspace file (C:/RodeoNetwork/AGENTS.md on Windows, ~/RodeoNetwork/AGENTS.md elsewhere) does not exist, tell the user this looks like a fresh install and offer to run the rodeo-network-setup skill. Skip the check when the file exists."
